Package io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe

Class Series

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<E>
java.util.ArrayList<Double>
io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe.Series
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Double>, Collection<Double>, List<Double>, RandomAccess
public class Series extends ArrayList<Double> implements Serializable, Cloneable
Represents a specialized list of numerical values designed to facilitate mathematical and statistical operations. It extends the ArrayList class, adding methods for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization. This class provides functionality for common statistical calculations, data transformations, grouping, and plotting.

  • Method Details

    • sample

      public Series sample(int n, boolean replacement)
      Generates a sample Series by randomly selecting elements from the current Series. The sampling can be done with or without replacement based on the given parameter.
      Parameters:
      n - The number of elements to sample from the Series. Must be a non-negative integer.
      replacement - A boolean indicating whether sampling should be with replacement. If true, elements can be selected multiple times; otherwise, selected elements are removed from the source before the next draw. If false and n > size() then the sample will contain size() elements.
      Returns:
      A new Series containing the sampled elements.

    • groupBy

      public Map<Double,Series> groupBy(ToDoubleFunction<Double> groupFunction)
      Groups the elements of the Series based on the result of applying the specified grouping function. The grouping operation partitions the Series into subsets where all elements within a subset produce the same result when the grouping function is applied. For example, for grouping negative and positive values: series.groupBy(v -> v > 0 ? 1d : 0d);
      Parameters:
      groupFunction - a function that computes a grouping key (double value) for each element in the Series
      Returns:
      a map where the keys are the unique grouping values produced by the groupFunction, and the values are Series containing the elements that correspond to each group

      Transforms the elements of the current Series by applying a specified mapping function to each element and returns a new Series containing the mapped values.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      A new Series containing the values resulting from applying the mapping function to each element.

    • test

      public Series test(Predicate<Double> test)
      Tests each element in the series against the provided predicate and maps the results. Converts elements that satisfy the predicate to 1.0 and those that do not to 0.0.

    • zscore

      public Series zscore()
      Computes the z-score for all elements of the series. The z-score is calculated as (value - mean) / standard_deviation.
      Returns:
      A new Series where each value is the z-score of the corresponding value in the original series.

    • normalized

      public Series normalized()
      Returns a new Series with its values normalized to a range between 0 and 1. Normalization is achieved by scaling each value using the formula: (value - min) / (max - min), where min and max are the minimum and maximum values of the current Series, respectively.
      Returns:
      a new Series where all values are normalized to the range [0, 1].

      Returns:
      a new series with sorted elements

    • cumsum

      public Series cumsum()
      Computes the cumulative sum of the elements in the current Series. The method sequentially adds each element of the Series to a running total and stores the result in a new Series, such that each value in the resulting Series represents the sum of all preceding elements (inclusive). If the series has nan values Double.NaN is returned.
      Returns:
      a new Series containing the cumulative sum of the elements in the original Series.

      public double sum()
      Computes and returns the sum of all numerical values contained in the Series. If the Series is empty or has nan values, the method returns Double.NaN.
      Returns:
      the sum of all values in the Series as a double, or Double.NaN if the Series is empty or has nan values

      Returns:

    • max

      public double max()

      Returns:
      the maximum value as a double, or Double.NaN if the series is empty or has nan values

    • mean

      public double mean()
      Calculates and returns the mean of the numerical values in the Series. The mean is the arithmetic average, computed by summing all elements and dividing by the number of elements. If the Series is empty or has nan values, the method returns Double.NaN.
      Returns:
      the mean value of the Series as a double, or Double.NaN if the Series is empty or has nan values

    • var

      public double var()
      Computes and returns the variance of the numerical values in the Series. Variance is a measure of the dispersion of the data, calculated as the average of the squared differences from the mean. If the Series is empty or has nan values, the method returns Double.NaN.
      Returns:
      the variance of the Series as a double. If the Series is empty or has nan values, the method returns Double.NaN.

    • std

      public double std()
      Computes and returns the standard deviation of the numerical values in the Series. The standard deviation is a measure of the dispersion or spread of the values relative to their mean.
      Returns:
      the standard deviation as a double, calculated as the square root of the variance. If the series is empty or has nan values Double.NaN is returned.

    • middle

      public double middle()
      Computes and returns the middle value of the series. The middle value is determined by skipping half of the series' elements. If the series is empty or has nan values, Double.NaN is returned.
      Returns:
      the middle value of the series as a double, or Double.NaN if the series is empty or has nan values

    • first

      public double first()
      Retrieves the first element of the series. If the series is empty, it returns Double.NaN.
      Returns:
      the first element of the series, or Double.NaN if the series is empty

    • last

      public double last()
      Returns the last element of the series. If the series is empty, it returns Double.NaN.
      Returns:
      the last element of the series, or Double.NaN if the series is empty

    • median

      public double median()
      Calculates the median of the elements in the series. The median is the middle value in a sorted list of numbers. If the series has an even number of elements, the median is calculated as the average of the two middle numbers.
      Returns:
      the median value of the series as a double. If the series is empty Double.NaN is returned.

    • hasNan

      public boolean hasNan()
      Checks if the Series contains any Double.NaN values.
      Returns:
      true if the Series contains at least one Double.NaN value, false otherwise

    • statistics

      public Map<String,Double> statistics()
      Computes and returns a map of statistical metrics for the current Series. These metrics include size, mean, standard deviation, variance, minimum, maximum, first element, median, last element, and a flag indicating the presence of any NaN values.
      Returns:
      a map where keys are the names of statistical metrics (e.g., "size", "mean", "std", "var", etc.) and values are the corresponding computed values as Doubles
